blocks.html: Go Hotels Plus Naga is slated to formally open in the first half of 2022. Situated next to Summit Hotel Naga, the newest offering of RLC’s upgraded essential value brand will showcase modern designs and Instagram-worthy spaces. Its rooms and furniture are carefully appointed to provide maximum comfort and relaxation at affordable rates. Meanwhile, the hotel’s meeting rooms, which can comfortably seat as many as 15 persons, provide a productive environment for professional engagements.
SUMMIT HOTEL NAGA OPENS FOR BUSINESS AND LEISURE TRAVELERS ALIKE

Summit Hotels, on the other hand, recently expanded to Camarines Sur, a region brimming with an interesting blend of aquatic attractions, historic sites, and business opportunities. Summit Hotel Naga officially opened its doors to business travelers and local tourists alike last January 2022.

Strategically situated in one of the Philippines’ most exciting touristdestinations, Summit Hotel Naga is the ideal jumping point to explore the region’s famed landmarks and attractions, including the CamSurWatersports Complex, the white sand beaches of Caramoan, and the Basilica of Our Lady of Peñafrancia. It is likewise a mere 1-minute walk from Robinsons Place Naga, a premier 3-level full-service mall. “Our newest Summit Hotel offers 60 spacious guest rooms – a mix of 56 Deluxe Rooms and 4 Summit Suites,” says Joy de Mesa, Group Director of Sales and Marketing. De Mesa adds that each room is thoughtfully designed to cater to guests’ every need.

Summit Hotel Naga’s deluxe rooms are furnished with five-star beddings, the plushest pillows, a 42-inch flat-screen LED television, as well as ample desk space for business travelers. Meanwhile, the Summit Suites, named Peñafrancia, Makusog, Magayon, and Voyadores, which pay homage to the Bicolano culture, are spaciously designed to include a receiving/living room area. “The suites are tastefully decorated - from the wood paneled floors and the furnishings in neutral tones, to the bathtub inside a spacious bathroom’, says Angelo Ascue, Assistant Director of Sales. The promise of relaxing stays is fulfilled through the combination of luxe five-star beddings and Summit Hotel’s signature pillows found in each cozy suite. Furthermore, Summit Suites affords its guests amazing views of Mt. Isarog Nature Park. Mt. Isarog Nature Park is about half an hour away from Naga City Park and offers nature lovers a variety of activities, including bird watching, biking, and trekking.
SAMPLE AND ENJOY LOCAL FARE AT CAFÉ SUMMIT

Guests can also enjoy a variety of Bicolano specialties in Café Summit, Summit Hotel Naga’s allday dining restaurant. The specially prepared menu features several must-try dishes including its signature Sorsi, a local version of scallops from Sorsogon, the lava burger, featuring house-made burger patty topped with melted cheese and BBQ sauce served in black buns, and Café Summit’s version of mint chocolate dome that will surely satisfy every sweet tooth.
THE PREFERRED BUSINESSMAN’S HOTEL IN THE REGION

Summit Hotel Naga is likewise poised to become the preferred business conference hotel in the City. “Summit Hotel Naga offers a complete banquet facilities portfolio best suited for both business and social events,” shares Angelo Ascue, Assistant Director of Sales. Its collection of business conference rooms include the 46-sqm Asog function room, and the 566- sqm pillarless Isarog Grand Ballroom, which may be partitioned into 3 separate ballrooms and can accommodate up to 600 guests. A 276-sqm outdoor patio is also available for those who prefer to dine alfresco. On top of all these, Summit Hotel Naga is equipped with a fitness center and an outdoor pool for guests who wish to relax after a hard day’s work. Summit Hotel Naga and Go Hotels Plus Naga are located in Robinsons Place Naga Complex, Almeda Highway, Barangay Triangulo, Naga City, Camarines Sur
